decisions.mitterrand: Accept requested interval for appearance only. Keep 1994 filename as source-stated label with uncertain photograph date, not an established capture year or office boundary.
decisions.juppe: Accept requested illustrative appearance interval; registry-derived November 1994 boundary does not establish effective office tenure. Preserve 17 MB original. Original input read failed before generation (invalid base64 padding); successful generation used the retained proportional 1500px-wide JPEG, with no crop or person alteration, pinned as actual input.
decisions.hollande: Return one mid/late-period interpretation from the 2007 face for review. The eleven-year window is not a year-by-year likeness claim; Claude may propose an earlier split before registration.
decisions.fabius: Use verified 1984 reference with explicitly disclosed ageing for 1992. Optional closer-photo search was not attempted and is not claimed.
decisions.background: Outputs retain the generated dark-teal backdrop with slight tonal shading. No pixel-exact flat-background claim; no output retouching.
